note: ORPHAN Pro 22:13 — the sluggard says, 'there is a lion outside! I shall be killed in the streets!'

dims.v: evasive sloth — the lazy man inventing dangers to avoid work
the sluggard who says 'there is a lion outside!' — sloth so inventive in evasion that it conjures imaginary dangers to justify staying idle, laziness rationalising itself with absurd fears
the laziness that invents perils rather than go to work

atsel (sluggard) — 'the SLUGGARD says, 'there is a lion outside!'' (22:13; cf 26:13); sloth is fertile in excuses, conjuring imaginary lions to avoid the street and the work. The lazy mind invents dangers where there are none.
